title: Towards Implementing Cloud-Based Workflows for Near Real-Time Processing of Large 4D STEM Experimental Datasets
content: Four-dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4D STEM) experiments are becoming increasingly popular for high resolution imaging of a vast range of materials in both the physical and life science [1, 2]. Recent advances in electron detection technology have enabled fast frame rates (up to 120 kHz) with extended dynamic range, allowing high-throughput experiments that generate large volumes of data with rich information content [3].
